measure_starts_after_application.fail: Work on this measure began on {start}, before the application was filed on {filed} - most programmes fund nothing at all once the measure has started
measure_starts_after_application.unevidenced: Work began early, on {start}, and the file says the authority permitted it, but names no written permission
measure_starts_after_application.evidence: Record the reference of the written permission to start early, so the file defends itself
measure_starts_after_application.suggestion: Check the programme's terms before spending more. If the early start was permitted in writing, record it; if it was not, ask the authority before the application goes any further

costs_fall_in_the_award_period.before: Draw {draw} claims costs from before {period_start}, the day the award period opens
costs_fall_in_the_award_period.after: Draw {draw} claims costs from after {period_end}, the day the award period closes
costs_fall_in_the_award_period.spans: Draw {draw} reaches outside the award period at both ends, {period_start} to {period_end}
costs_fall_in_the_award_period.suggestion: Move the costs outside the window into a draw of their own and take them up with the authority, rather than letting one claim carry both

own_share_is_covered.fail: The programme requires an own contribution of {rate} percent, which is {required}, but the application records {recorded}
own_share_is_covered.suggestion: Name where the remaining own contribution comes from before submitting, because the programme computes it on the eligible base rather than on the project total

cumulation_within_aid_intensity.fail: The {count} applications on this project come to {intensity} percent of the eligible costs, over the {cap} percent ceiling the strictest of their programmes declares
cumulation_within_aid_intensity.suggestion: Public funding cumulates across programmes and across levels of government. Reduce one request, or ask whether the measures can be separated so each carries its own costs

proof_of_use_is_on_time.missing: The award period ended on {period_end} and no final proof of use has been started
proof_of_use_is_on_time.late: The final proof of use was due on {due} and was submitted on {submitted}
proof_of_use_is_on_time.overdue: The final proof of use was due on {due} and has not been submitted
proof_of_use_is_on_time.suggestion: Submit what exists rather than waiting for it to be complete. Most authorities extend a deadline on request and none extend one that has already passed

errors.programme_code_taken: A programme with this code already exists in this country
errors.programme_has_applications: This programme has applications and cannot be deleted. Close it instead.
errors.application_code_taken: An application with this code already exists on this project
errors.approved_application_not_deletable: An approved application cannot be deleted. Set its status to withdrawn or closed instead.
errors.approval_needs_period_end: An approval needs the end of its award period, because every later deadline counts from it
errors.draw_needs_approval: Funds can only be drawn against an approved application
errors.paid_draw_not_deletable: A draw that has been paid cannot be deleted
errors.eligible_exceeds_amount: The eligible amount cannot exceed the amount
